method.scope: One complete declared round: full two-file before/current diffs; full current local-concentration/camp-separation/victory-cost H2s in scripts and final; full preceding diversion-explained and following reserves-committed H2s for knowledge, movement and transition dependencies; full T020; full force settings020/040/050 and place070. HTML comments were masked before reading.
method.isolation: No author, review, notes or draft body was opened. Only actual current manuscript, parent/setting text, temporary raw before sources, unchanged contract questions and own classification fingerprints supply this round.

common: unlocated inventories/unmarked gaze changes/vague impressions replacing required values
speech: neighboring action repeated in another register
scripts: interpretive label instead of performable operation
missing view/impossible position or sightline/unsupported core appearance
screenplay: weight lost to uniform short beat

method.profiles: Changed t020 units test all applicable named expression, speech, execution, parent-differentiation and fidelity questions. Unchanged neighboring H2s test affected knowledge/role/number/movement/transition dependencies only; they are not reopened for stylistic taste. Settings/treatment are checked as document and canonical owners.
method.sentence_results: Each listed unit was actually read against its profile; - means no clear applicable failure in that inspected scope. No fresh negative is assigned outside coverage.
method.locators: hN selects current H2 order; pN counts annotation-masked Markdown blocks including headings/navigation; sN is a punctuation locator, not a linguistic parse. Spans address annotation-masked UTF-8-sig decoded source.
method.quote_policy: Before/after and evidence quotes are literal source substrings within the cited H2/block. NFC plus Unicode-whitespace collapse would be the only allowed normalized fallback; none is used.
method.preservation: Inherited basic assignments, a short battlefield order, branch identity, simultaneous eastern pressure and western attack are required values. A new unrelated action, speech flourish or decorative variation is not required to avoid copying. Repaired passages receive yes again only for a clear named failure.
limits: No fresh whole-work review or initial table regeneration is claimed. The 67/81/82 sets are hash inventories only.
Exact numerical east/west infantry shares are not specified, and this inspection does not invent them or require a new troop quota.
The casualty allocation does not require every branch loss to be separately depicted; a waiting position before a signal is not treated as a claim that cavalry never participates later.
Neighboring unchanged parents019/021 were not fully reread this round; current contextual hashes and prior readings are kept distinct from fresh T020/settings reading.
No external historical verification, media, measured travel time or oral performance was tested.

decision.reason: The western assault now uses a local infantry reserve split from the existing contributed infantry; a separate share continues eastern pressure. The cavalry-centered mobile army is not silently converted into transported infantry. The fortress retains defenders, Sokro's force cuts western routes, Namgeon's central cavalry waits separately, and Gaesomun signals the local reserve only after the escort clears. The final gives the same branches their own spatial placement, approach, carrier attention and continuing eastern sound; necessary formation assignments and short commands are not clear copied realization. No supported new named expression, execution or parent-fidelity failure is established.

evidence.quote: Their local officers assign one share of the contributed infantry to eastern pressure and keep another with Gaesomun for the western attack.
He signals the local infantry reserve to press the camp side of the western bottleneck.
Their local officers divide that existing infantry contribution: one share moves toward the eastern approach, while another stays with Gaesomun outside the camp for the western assault.
With the local infantry reserve waiting beside the central cavalry outside the camp, Gaesomun receives a signal that the escort is clear.
Do not place the same people simultaneously on the routes and in the frontal attack.
Infantry is not carried along. Against each direction the mobile force joins roughly 10,000–20,000 infantry from local fortresses and forces, then moves quickly and joins infantry at the next front.
Subtracting roughly 5,000 immediately lost to duty from the mobile army leaves about 35,000. The local infantry return under their own fortress officers and continue its defense.

dependency_checks.subject: troop origin and branch identity
dependency_checks.reason: Both infantry shares are portions of the existing local contribution, remain under local officers, and do not enlarge the mobile army or empty fortress defense.

dependency_checks.subject: simultaneous east/west tasks
dependency_checks.reason: The eastern share stays engaged while a separately waiting local reserve moves west. Sokro's route force and Namgeon's heavy cavalry remain separate; nobody is required in both infantry positions at once.

dependency_checks.subject: knowledge and signal order
dependency_checks.reason: The return from audience-only diversion knowledge leaves Gaesomun with movement reports. Zheng's knowledge that northern armies left belongs to T020. Eastern pressure and the escort-clear signal precede the western reserve attack.

dependency_checks.subject: escape and closure
dependency_checks.reason: The southern gap and individual escape remain; no complete annihilation or confirmed Zheng battlefield death is added. Some fighting continues while organization fails.

dependency_checks.subject: numbers and local return
dependency_checks.reason: Five thousand unavailable and thirty-five thousand remaining refer to the mobile force; local infantry returns to its fortress officers. No new troops are added to that retained total or carried into the later southern mobile march.

dependency_checks.subject: postbattle movement and supply
dependency_checks.reason: The late-tenth-month action still passes through injury/equipment/route preparation to early-twelfth-month Sinseong assembly. Following horse feed, seed exclusions, dispersed stocks and separate seven-thousand-light-cavalry shares remain distinct.
